# tweekersnut/cache

> 标签: cache, caching, file-cache, performance, psr, redis, session-cache

## 简介

A high-performance, pluggable PHP caching library with Redis, file, session, and memory drivers.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
